label: Jacob

text.NESTLE1904 MAT 1:14: Ἀζὼρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ, Σαδὼκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχείμ, Ἀχεὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιούδ,
text.KJV MAT 1:14: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
text.NESTLE1904 MAT 1:15: Ἐλιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλεάζαρ, Ἐλεάζαρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαθθάν, Μαθθὰν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ,
text.KJV MAT 1:15: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
text.NESTLE1904 MAT 1:16: Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἄνδρα Μαρίας, ἐξ ἧς ἐγεννήθη Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Χριστός.
text.KJV MAT 1:16: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

A.name: Jacob
A.line: son of Matthan in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:15)
family: son-of matthan (Matthan, son of Eleazar in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:15))
father-of joseph-6 (Joseph, son of Jacob in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:16))

B.name: Jacob
family: son-of isaac (Isaac, son of Abraham and Sarah (GEN 17:21))
son-of rebekah (Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel, grandaughter of Nahor (GEN 22:23))
brother-of esau (Esau, firstborn son of Isaac (GEN 25:25-26))
servant-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
father-of dan (Dan, fifth-born son of Jacob (GEN 30:5), son of Bilhah, Rachel's )
father-of naphtali (Naphtali, sixth-born son of Jacob (GEN 30:7), son of Bilhah, Rachel's )

why: Matthew 1:15 says Μαθθὰν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ, identifying Jacob as Matthan’s son; verse 16 identifies him as the father of Joseph, Mary’s husband. Both relationships match A, whereas B is Isaac’s son.
